description: This bar chart illustrates the Recall@10 metric for four different methods: “Ours”, “- critiquing”, “- scoring”, and “- ranking”. The horizontal axis displays the method names, listed alphabetically, while the vertical axis represents the Recall@10 value, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, incrementing by 0.1. A single bar represents each method, colored in golden for “Ours” with a value of approximately 0.32, and in shades of blue for the other three methods. The “- critiquing” bar is approximately 0.29, “- scoring” is approximately 0.16, and “- ranking” is approximately 0.23. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not contain grouped or stacked bars.
